league_audio.name: NBA League Pass (audio)
league_audio.what: Every League Pass subscription includes live radio broadcasts of all NBA games (League Pass $109.99 / Premium $159.99 per season prepay, monthly plans also offered).

league_audio.name: SiriusXM NBA Radio
league_audio.what: Team radio feeds on SiriusXM (subscription, available anywhere); Orlando Magic page lists SiriusXM channels 106 or 212 for Magic games. Kings Radio (2026-27) also on SiriusXM.

league_audio.name: ESPN Radio national NBA package
league_audio.what: ESPN Radio nationally broadcast the 2026 NBA Finals (30th year of Finals coverage; Marc Kestecher, Doris Burke, P.J. Carlesimo) plus NBA Countdown pregame; ESPN Unlimited subscribers got dedicated home/away team audio feeds (KnicksCast/SpursCast) in the ESPN App. Regular-season national games also air (e.g. ESPN Radio carried 9 Warriors games in 2025-26 per Warriors/Audacy release).

league_audio.name: Team apps / NBA App
league_audio.what: Teams stream their radio calls in team apps (often geo-limited, e.g. Magic app and iHeart stream only within 75 miles of Orlando); Warriors broadcasts also stream via NBA.com and the NBA app per the 2025-26 Warriors/95.7 extension coverage.
